resources.string: BIOS files are optional; missing or incorrect files do not prevent games from launching. Place BIOS files in the app-private files/system/ folder. mGBA uses a verified BIOS when “Use BIOS file if found” is enabled (on by default); skipping the BIOS intro also requires a BIOS. Detection requires the expected filename and MD5. A valid file found under another name is copied using its canonical filename.
